why: Source: read one segment off gridlines, read total, starting value, compound both and compare at two option years, minimum-years decision (about 6 steps); question: the same gridline read, total, starting value, two compounding checks at option years and the minimum-years decision (about 6 steps; testing 4 and 6 years instead of 2 and 4 is the same work).

Source: spot that hand-sorted is 100% minus the last flow stage (trap), two complements times volumes, difference (4 steps); question: the same trap on the last tag-reader stage, two complements times volumes, difference (4 steps).

Source: find the right chart and rating, scale new customers to 3x, two products, difference (4 steps); question: find the price chart and rating 3, scale non-buyers to 2x, two products, difference (4 steps).

Source: labour and electricity cost (or saving) for each model with a cents-to-dollars conversion, annual saving, times three-year payback threshold (about 5 steps); question: the same labour and electricity calculations, conversion, saving and three-year threshold (about 5 steps).
Source: two profits (revenue minus costs or revenue times margin) and their difference (3 steps); question: the same two profits and difference (3 steps).

Source: compute usage per restaurant for both chains and compare, plus three statements rejected without calculation (2 checks, about 3 steps); question: the same per-restaurant division and comparison plus three no-calculation rejections (about 3 steps).

Source: convert income to dollars by dividing by the rate, then multiply by the PPP factor, pick the formula (3 steps); question: hours by dividing calls by rate, then multiply by wage, pick the formula (3 steps).

Source: sum contacted and total by company size and compare shares, sum overall contact share, compare no-contact pools for medium vs large, reject the no-data statement (about 5 steps); question: the same sums and comparisons across the same 9x3 table layout (about 5 steps).
Source: sum twelve labelled revenue bars, sum twelve labelled staff bars, divide and convert millions to dollars (3 to 4 steps); question: the same two sums, division and conversion (3 to 4 steps).

Source: recognise driver growth is total times share (trap), compute products to check greatest and least of one driver and least of the other, reject the unsupported figure (about 5 steps); question: the same recognition, the same three product-based checks and one no-calculation rejection (about 5 steps).
